description: Small hand-labeled dataset for evaluating dictionary skill extraction. Expected skills use canonical taxonomy names (aliases in the text resolve to them). Samples 5 and 9 also guard word-boundary behavior (JavaScript must not produce Java; 'Research' must not produce R). This is demonstration data, NOT a benchmark.
